note: Gold set for the pgvector service. Queries are grounded ONLY in each KB doc's title / user-experience / cause (production docs have NO 'Symptoms' field). Tiers: strong (should resolve on turn 1), weak (under-specified -> needs 1 follow-up), ambiguous (confusable between 2 KBs -> needs 1 follow-up), out_of_kb (valid-Outlook-but-uncovered or off-topic -> must never resolve to a KB). 'followup' is the extra detail a user gives when asked, used by the end-to-end layers to simulate round 2 deterministically (no LLM needed).
